info.name: TigerSprite
info.summary: Export Markdown files to PDF with TigerSprite
info.description:
Adds a TigerSprite Export to PDF action for Markdown files in Nextcloud.
- One-click conversion from the file context menu - Download PDF or save to current directory - Supports wkhtmltopdf and dompdf engines - Automatic cache cleanup - Multi-language support
info.author: adam
